data.scope: The 12 translate omissions only; separate from all 489 cross-axis minimum-size equivalences and the 21 other sizing-intent recommendations.

supersedes.relation: The earlier conditional status is resolved here; leave that original triage receipt unchanged.

findings: All 12 recorded operations are sheen-only boxShadow changes. Current native fills, borders, opacity and remaining shadows still paint; none is an intentionally cleared or hidden decorative primitive.
All 12 current native computed styles retain position:absolute but have left:0, top:0 and no translate. Their own node-info coordinates also report local x:0,y:0.
Original full-board cached CSS retains the complete nonzero left/top/translate tuples. The current immediate parents retain the same 1440x700 geometry and origin offsets as the original parents.

All ancestor chains were reconciled to their current source artboards. The Terminal fixture artboard reports null automatic size/world coordinates for descendants, but its actual native whole-board screenshot renders the retained pill at the upper-left. Null model coordinates were not used as measured world geometry.

Native whole-board captures show the OS callout backgrounds stacked at the upper-left, the Explore background misplaced at the left edge of its lower section, and both Terminal backgrounds covering the upper-left brand region.
Restoring translate alone would leave the substantial original left/top offsets missing. Use the complete original tuple, or a separately qualified equivalent-position wrapper fallback.

fallbackRiskAssessment.eligibleInObservedCss: All translations are two px lengths. No rotation, scale, transform, perspective, transform-origin override, mask or clip-path is present in the original affected styles or inspected source ancestors. Under those observed properties, translation composes by simple addition.
fallbackRiskAssessment.transformOrigin: Pure translation is independent of transform origin. Do not generalize this arithmetic to rotated/scaled/percentage-based targets.
fallbackRiskAssessment.clipping: Each current immediate parent has overflow:visible. Keep wrapper overflow:visible to preserve borders and shadow spread; retain existing artboard clipping. All restored rectangle border boxes fit their 1440x700 parent extents.
fallbackRiskAssessment.stacking: Insert the wrapper at the original rectangle sibling position with no new z-index, filter, opacity or transform on the wrapper. Keep the rectangle original opacity and paint on the child. This preserves callout backgrounds behind their separate text/marker siblings.
fallbackRiskAssessment.flow: All targets were and remain absolute; an absolute wrapper with the original fixed dimensions does not add flex-flow space.
fallbackRiskAssessment.doublePainting: Do not park/clear the old owned rectangle until exact replacement placement and rendering are proven. Remove only the duplicate owned misplaced instance after proof.
fallbackRiskAssessment.nativeQualification: No fallback was tried here. Native Frame/Rectangle clone placement can differ from ordinary CSS expectations; actual qualification belongs to root using the already authorized carrier and existing controls.

scopeLimits: No before raster was synthesized or reconstructed. Before positioning comes from exact earlier full-board JSX context; after evidence is current native styles/hierarchy and native rendered boards.
No old detached ID was queried as live before proof. Source-only/fixture labels and substantive content remain unchanged.
Other overlaps or clipping visible on these source references were not reopened or attributed to this repair.

No blanket conclusion about all absolute mutation roots; the isolated-root positioning blind spot is a concrete reason for root to reuse full-board coordinate evidence on any remaining relevant roots.
